title: Vahakni City crowned League A champions
description: Vahakni City - Dvin 87-80 Vahakni City celerbated League A title. They held off Dvin to clinch the trophy. The hosts trailed by 3 points after first quarter, but they rallied back to get the 5-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 87-80. Vahakni City looked well-organized offensively handing out 22 assists. American forward Alvin Brown (210-90, college: USC Aiken) stepped up with a double-double by scoring 20 points and 12 rebounds for the winners and his fellow American import guard Darious Clark (193-90, college: Slippery Rock) chipped in 23 points and 7 rebounds. Clark is a former Eurobasket Summer League player, which is considered top international summer league in the market. Five Vahakni City players scored in double figures. The former international forward Davit Khachatryan (210-0) responded with a double-double by scoring 21 points, 16 rebounds and 4 assists…
